chunks: From him, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from al-Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about the Christians of the Arabs, are their slaughtered animals eaten? He said, 'Ali (peace be upon him) forbade eating their slaughtered animals, their game, and intermarrying with them.'

key_terms.نَصَارَى الْعَرَبِ: Christians of the Arabs (specifically those living in Arabia or of Arab descent)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating the meat of Arab Christians according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the juristic principle of *talfiq* (following specific practices) by linking Imam Abu Ja'far al-Baqir’s ruling to the established precedent of Imam Ali. It underscores the distinct status of Arab Christians (*Nasara al-Arab*) in early Islamic jurisprudence, where their meat and marriage were prohibited, reflecting a stricter application of the People of the Book (*Ahl al-Kitab*) rules compared to later generalizations.
